App.Title: Translations
App.NoSelection: Choose a message to start translating

Page.MetaDescription: A focused desktop editor for Runic Translations workspaces

ExternalChanges.Title: Files changed outside the editor
ExternalChanges.UnsavedIntact: Your local drafts, repair text, and workflow changes are still intact.
ExternalChanges.ReloadLatest: Reload to read the latest versions.

ExternalCompare.Description: Compare the editor base with the current file, then keep or merge the change.
ExternalCompare.ReloadKeepMerged: Reload base and keep merged draft

RecoveredDrafts.Title: Unsaved work was recovered
RecoveredDrafts.One: One document draft was found in local application storage.
RecoveredDrafts.Many: document drafts were found in local application storage.

Fatal.CouldNotOpen: Could not open this translation workspace
Fatal.NoCatalog: No Runic Translations catalog was found.
Fatal.RecoveryRefresh: Recovery completed; reload the workspace to refresh it.

Recovery.Title: An interrupted change needs your decision
Recovery.NoFurtherEditing: No further editing is allowed until it is resolved.
Recovery.RestoreBefore: Restore files from before the change
Recovery.JournalNote: Both choices use the bounded local journal. The journal is removed only after recovery succeeds.

Welcome.OpenOrCreate: Open an existing workspace or create a compiler-valid project from scratch.
Welcome.TraversalNote: Traversal stays inside this boundary and ignores links, dependencies, and generated output.
Welcome.StoredLocalProfile: Stored only in your local application profile

EmptySelection.Description: Choose a message from the sidebar to review or edit its translation.

Preview.Title: Preview
Preview.Description: Uses the same rules as the generated application message
Preview.EditToBuild: Edit the message to build a preview.
Preview.SafeMarkup: Semantic markup is displayed as a data tree. Names and attributes are never interpreted as trusted HTML.

Quality.Title: Quality
Quality.CsvOrder: CSV is ordered by key and finding kind.

OpenProject.Title: Open translation project
OpenProject.Description: Catalogs are discovered below this workspace boundary. You will choose one if several are found.

Repair.Description: Edit the raw JSON below. The canonical compiler must accept it before it can replace the file.

About.DiagnosticBundleDescription: The zip contains version/runtime information, catalog counts, and grouped diagnostic IDs. It excludes workspace paths, file names, messages, source JSON, and translations.
About.BundleNoUpload: The application never uploads this bundle. Sharing it is an explicit action outside the editor.
About.LocalStateDescription: Stored only in this user’s application profile. The inspection never reveals paths or draft text.
About.ClearLocalStateNote: Clearing affects only future recovery and launches; it does not modify workspace files or discard the work currently open in this window.
About.LicenseNote: Runic Translations is MIT licensed. The packaged application includes LICENSE.txt and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

Terminology.Title: Project terminology
Terminology.Description: Terms stay in the optional versioned sidecar and are checked locally. Nothing is sent to a service.

Mutation.Description: Compiler-backed workspace change. Review the affected files before committing.
Mutation.CopyStarterValuesDescription: Copied text keeps the new catalog compiler-valid and can then be translated.
Mutation.FilesDeletedDescription: All resource documents for this locale will be deleted after the preview is confirmed.
Mutation.MessageKeyDescription: Use dots to organize messages into groups.
Mutation.InitialTextDescription: The initial value is added to every language so strict projects stay valid.
Mutation.RenameDescription: The change is applied across every locale and layer where the source message exists.
Mutation.DeleteDescription: The message will be removed from every locale and layer. The preview below lists every file that will change.
Mutation.IrreversibleConfirm: I understand this workspace change cannot be undone.
Mutation.IrreversibleDescription: It is excluded from the local undo history. Review the listed files before continuing.

ProjectWizard.Title: New translation project
ProjectWizard.Description: Create compiler-valid translations without overwriting an existing directory.
ProjectWizard.NoOverwrite: The editor creates a new directory and never overwrites an existing one.
ProjectWizard.DirectoryDescription: Enter an absolute path or a path relative to the editor process.
ProjectWizard.CatalogIdDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots, and hyphens.
ProjectWizard.WhichLanguages: Which languages does this project use?
ProjectWizard.LanguageDescription: One language is fully supported. Add translations now or later.
ProjectWizard.GeneratedApiDescription: These defaults work for most .NET and ESM consumers.
ProjectWizard.EnableEsmDescription: Generate tree-shakeable modules for TypeScript and browser applications.

ArtifactPreview.Title: Compiled artifact preview
ArtifactPreview.Description: In-editor rendering of the compiled message output. This never launches an external application.
ArtifactPreview.EditToPreview: Edit the message to build an artifact preview.
ArtifactPreview.Note: Both columns run the same compiler-normalized AST pipeline; markup stays semantic data and is never interpreted as HTML.

CommandPalette.Title: Command palette
CommandPalette.Description: Search editor commands and run them

SidebarPanels.ResizeTitle: Drag to resize · Double-click to reset

TranslationEditor.RawChangeDescription: Changes here affect the complete resource document.

Pattern.ChildrenDescription: Children · rendered as safe semantic data

Workflow.Title: Workflow
Workflow.ReviewerNotePlaceholder: Optional context for the next reviewer…
Workflow.SuggestionsPrivacy: Suggestions compare only translations already in this workspace. Network providers are disabled and no translation text leaves this application.
Workflow.EmptySuggestionsPrivacy: Terminology, review notes, source context, and translation-memory suggestions stay in the workspace. Network providers are disabled by default and require an explicit future workspace policy before they can receive text.

Composer.ValueWithoutSpecific: value without a more specific translation
Composer.SingularFormOf: Used for the language’s singular form of
Composer.NumberFormOf: Used for the language’s number form of
Composer.OrdinalFormOf: Used for the language’s ordinal form of
Composer.ShownWheneverUsed: Shown whenever this message is used.
Composer.VariablesBecomeChips: become protected, inspectable chips in the sentence.
Composer.OneTranslation: One translation is used in every situation
Composer.PluralFormsDescription: If wording changes with a number, add plural forms and translate each case separately.
Composer.RequiredFallbackDescription: Every structured message needs this final fallback, so its matching rule cannot be changed or removed.
Composer.StructuredCaseDescription: This case contains formatting or semantic markup. Edit its content blocks below.
Composer.ChooseWhenUsed: Choose when this translation is used
Composer.AdvancedStructureDescription: Inputs, formatters, and selection rules used by the translations above.
Composer.InputsDescription: Values supplied by application code. Translators insert them by typing
Composer.SelectionRulesDescription: Rules decide which translation case is used for a given input.
Composer.ReusableFormattersDescription: Optional named formats for dates, numbers, relative time, and other typed values.
Composer.CustomCaseDescription: Enter the exact value that should select this translation.
Composer.ExactCaseDescription: Enter the number that should select this translation instead of the locale’s normal plural form.
Composer.StructuredMessageSourceDescription: An escape hatch for exact schema-v2 source editing.

Interchange.Title: Interchange
Interchange.Description: Export portable XLIFF 2.1 or review JSON, then preview every import before it can change the workspace. Export paths stay inside the open workspace; import paths may be absolute or workspace-relative.
Interchange.XliffDescription: Export writes one target-locale document. Import always shows the proposed text and review-state changes first.
Interchange.FirstChangesOnly: Only the first 256 changes are displayed; the counts above include the entire import.
Interchange.ReviewDescription: Moves workflow state, notes, and approved-source evidence without replacing translation text. Local terminology remains local to the workspace.
